build_fk_model: build a FKModel neural network that predicts 3D keypoints from robot finger joint angles
build_ik_model: build an IKModel neural network that predicts joint angles from 3D keypoint positions
create_finger_fk_network: create a forward kinematics neural network for a single finger with configurable joint count
create_finger_ik_network: create an inverse kinematics neural network for a single finger with configurable joint count
run_fk_forward_pass: run a forward pass through FKModel to compute keypoints from normalized joint values
